name: Daniel
label: Premium listener annoyed by podcast ads
who: I pay for Spotify Premium mainly for music and only occasionally listen to podcasts there. I am frustrated that ads still play in podcasts even though I pay, so I prefer a dedicated podcast app like Overcast.
value_for_money: Feels that paying for Premium should remove podcast ads, and says the subscription loses value because ads still play; would pay a higher cost for a filter that removes podcasts and audiobooks, based on their post.
loyalty: Stays for music quality and ad-free music on Premium; would consider leaving for YouTube Premium or another app if podcasts keep being pushed and ads continue in podcasts.
pain_points: Podcast ads still play for Premium subscribers
Podcasts pushed onto the home screen and library
Fast-forwarding past podcast ads can trigger more ads
tone: Blunt and exasperated, with casual slang and occasional profanity.
